_about: Which OnMyLead version riders can actually get. The Help Center only publishes articles (and :::release blocks) for versions that are live. The build asks Apple which version is live (the free App Store lookup for the bundle ID) and falls back to `live` below when Apple can't be reached. See help/README.md.

prelaunch.notice: OnMyLead 1.0 for iPhone, iPad and Android is with Apple and Google for store review. These guides describe that first release.

versions.notes: First release, now for iPhone and iPad: everything through PR #116. Replaced build 2 (ad388f4, submitted 2026-10-13) in review. The same code goes to Google Play for Android phones and tablets.

unreleased.why: Built, but switched off until Apple grants the CarPlay entitlement (ONMYLEAD_CARPLAY=1 builds only).
Not supported. Sharing a post to Instagram (2.0) is fine; signing in with Instagram is not.
